clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Tirisfal, Balnir Farmstead lies ruined beyond the Bulwark. Once worked by the Balnir family, the estate now draws Scourge that slip past the defenses.

Snapdragons still bloom in the garden where the Balnir family worked their homestead for generations. When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron during the Third War, the farm was overrun and its people were lost. The buildings now rot among the hills of eastern Tirisfal.

Mindless Scourge slip past the Bulwark and gather among the farmstead's ruins. Forsaken deathguards watch the farm warily, while Undercity magi gather surviving snapdragons from its garden. They study the flowers to learn how deeply plague corruption has reached into the soil.
